(data source schema)
    description: Coralogix Scope. Scopes assign data access to users via groups. For more info please review - https://coralogix.com/docs/user-guides/account-management/user-management/scopes/.
default_expression  tftypes.String computed
    description: Default expression to use when no filter matches the query. Until further notice, this is limited to `true` (everything is included) or `false` (nothing is included). Use a version tag (e.g `<v1>true` or `<v1>false`)
description  tftypes.String computed
    description: Description of the scope. Optional.
display_name  tftypes.String computed
    description: Scope display name.
filters  nested LIST computed
    description: Filters applied to include data in the scope.
filters.entity_type  tftypes.String computed
    description: Entity type to apply the expression on
filters.expression  tftypes.String computed
    description: Expression to run
id  tftypes.String required
    description: Scope ID.
team_id  tftypes.String computed
    description: Associated team.
